channel.title: The Perpetual Lawnmower
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Perpetual Lawnmower" - A lawnmower that perpetually gets faster, till exposed to grass.

item.title: Re: The Perpetual Lawnmower
item.content:encoded:
Thanks for the feedback.

First of all, I was aiming for a fairly simple anomaly. I intended it to be a sort of 'introduction' to the new POI, and I'm not very confident in writing overly complicated or complex SCPs. I have realized that the narrative is fairly boring, so I have changed the SCP so that the speed effect was designed to be used as a prank, or defense mechanism in interview logs from the new POI included in the article. This at least adds a better narrative and purpose for the SCP to exist, as well as serve as a better introduction to the POI while being interesting on its own.

item.title: Re: The Perpetual Lawnmower
item.content:encoded:
I'm not super experience with criticism, so take this with a grain of salt.

The articles to me, are short stories. The ones that fail are usually the ones where there is no story behind it, just a strange object. If you think about it, the most famous SCPs are the ones where the testing logs tell a story, through the changes of the object or the things the object changes.

Again, I don't have any articles published so I probably don't even know what I'm talking about, but I've read enough of them to know what to look for.

item.title: Re: The Perpetual Lawnmower
item.content:encoded:
+ Cope Crit
- Close

Let's do this…

SCP-XXXX is a lawnmower that perpetually gets faster and doesn't suffer from wind resistance or interact with physical objects, until it comes into contact with grass. When it touches grass it becomes 'real' and suffers the effects of wind resistance from the speed that it is going.

Okay, right off the bat, this sounds uninteresting. It's a thing that does a thing.

This is an anomaly created by a new POI, who created this specifically to mow their lawn for them without any effort. This SCP was found moving away from this POI's place of residence at very high speeds, allowing the foundation to get a rough idea to where this POI lives.

The narrative sounds rather boring too. That being said… A new POI sounds interesting to me. Maybe a guy that's super lazy and makes anomalies to do work for him? That's an idea.

Its a dangerous lawnmower that moves super fast.

That's doesn't sound like a hook, that's just restating what the anomaly is.

Overall Thoughts: I believe you need more time to thing about a proper narrative. Your anomaly is very simple and that's okay, but no one will want to read it if they're is no narrative. I hope your idea goes somewhere man. Remember, you do you.

- Close

item.title: The Perpetual Lawnmower
item.content:encoded:
Seeking greenlight.
SCP Article.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a lawnmower that perpetually gets faster and doesn't suffer from wind resistance or interact with physical objects, until it comes into contact with grass. When it touches grass it becomes 'real' and suffers the effects of wind resistance from the speed that it is going.

Central Narrative: This is an anomaly created by a new POI, who created this specifically to mow their lawn for them without any effort. In interviews conducted by foundation personnel, it was revealed that the increasing speed was designed as a defense mechanism in the event that someone attempted to steal it for their own personal use. (Testing logs included in the article)

This SCP was found moving away from this POI's place of residence at very high speeds, allowing the foundation to get a rough idea to where this POI lives.

Hook: Its a dangerous lawnmower that was created by a dangerous POI with a sick sense of humor and karma.
